title: p-adic GRN Suite
description: Scientific software for p-adic analysis of Boolean and multi-valued gene regulatory networks. For a gene ordering, the scores mu_E, mu_A and mu_I sum the expanding, attracting and indifferent balls over the levels n = 0, ..., N-1, so that mu_E + mu_A + mu_I = N p^N.
